label: prf:color-elliptic
title: Proof of Color fibre as an elliptic curve
html: Write x_0=zx_1 and use x_0+x_1=C to eliminate both spacetime variables. The power-sum conditions \sum x_j^k=0 for k=2,3 then become polynomial in z and X=x_2+x_3+x_4, X_2=\sum_{i<j}x_ix_j, etc. Reducing by the Newton identities yields the cubic; its discriminant is a polynomial in z whose roots give the singular fibres.
